atgvAssist.sync.maxItems.description: Maximum items to synchronize from each service per run.

atgvAssist.sync.maxFileKb.description: Maximum indexed document size in KiB.

atgvAssist.rag.provider.description: AI provider: VS Code models, local Codex agent, cloud APIs, Ollama or compatible endpoints.

atgvAssist.rag.model.description: Approved AI model ID or Azure deployment (required for cloud APIs).

atgvAssist.rag.endpoint.description: Endpoint URL for Ollama, compatible services, or Azure OpenAI. Cloud API integrations require HTTPS.

atgvAssist.rag.maxChunks.description: Maximum retrieved chunks included in answer context.

atgvAssist.ai.preferredVendor.description: Optional vendor preference (e.g. openai, anthropic, copilot) for Auto model selection. Blank searches all accessible VS Code model providers.

atgvAssist.ai.selectedModel.description: Selected VS Code AI model identity. Empty uses automatic best-available selection. Use the model picker in the ATGV header.

atgvAssist.ai.useCopilotSdkForBaRecovery.description: Opt in to sending a Business Requirements document to the locally installed, authenticated Microsoft/GitHub Copilot SDK only if the selected AI provider fails during BA preflight or mapping. Requires Copilot SDK setup. Never switches providers without this consent.

atgvAssist.ai.codexTransport.description: Codex connection mode: HTTPS compatibility (recommended behind restrictive networks) or Codex default transport which may use WebSocket.

atgvAssist.updates.autoCheckExtension.description: Check GitHub Releases for extension updates. Saved across ATGV resets.

atgvAssist.updates.autoCheckLibrary.description: Check SDLC Library main for newer commits. Saved across ATGV resets.

atgvAssist.updates.promptForUpdates.description: Show a confirmation modal when updates become available. Saved across ATGV resets.

atgvAssist.updates.checkOnStartup.description: Check for updates after VS Code starts. Saved across ATGV resets.

atgvAssist.selfImprovement.captureErrors.description: Record sanitized ATGV errors locally for the issue-reporting workflow. Reports are never sent automatically.

atgvAssist.selfImprovement.captureSlowOp.description: Record slow startup prerequisite scans locally for performance investigation.

atgvAssist.selfImprovement.autoMaintenan.description: Run idle automatic coding improvement within 12:00–12:59 local time when VS Code is active. Verify PAT read/write access, version every tested repair, create PRs and automatically merge only after required GitHub checks succeed.

atgvAssist.selfImprovement.maintenanceTi.description: Time zone for noon-to-1 PM coding maintenance. Use system for the computer's local timezone, or an IANA zone (e.g. Asia/Kuala_Lumpur).

untrustedWorkspaces.description: ATGV connection secrets and enterprise knowledge synchronization require a trusted workspace.
